lessons.title: Greetings and introductions
lessons.description: Learn common greetings and how to introduce yourself politely.
objectives: Introduce yourself with a short sentence.

sections.heading: Useful dialogue
sections.body:
A: Hello! What is your name?
B: My name is Sara. What is your name?
A: I'm Omar. Nice to meet you.
B: Nice to meet you, too.

sections.heading: Language tip
sections.body: Use “What is your name?” to ask for a person's name. “I'm…” is a natural short form of “I am…”.

quiz.question: Which sentence introduces your name?
quiz.explanation: “My name is…” is a common way to introduce yourself.

lessons.title: Talking about things you like
lessons.description: Say what you like and ask another person about their preferences.
objectives: Give a simple positive or negative answer.

sections.heading: Ask and answer
sections.body: A: What do you like?\nB: I like books. What about you?\nA: I like music.

sections.heading: Language tip
sections.body: Use “I like + noun” to talk about preferences. For example: “I like books.”

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence.
quiz.explanation: With “I”, use the base verb “like”.

lessons.title: Daily routines and simple verbs
lessons.description: صف يومك بجمل قصيرة وتعلّم أفعالًا شائعة في الحياة اليومية.
objectives: استخدام أفعال يومية في جمل بسيطة

vocabulary.example: I eat breakfast in the morning.

sections.heading: A simple daily routine
sections.body: I wake up at seven. I eat breakfast. I work during the day, and I study English in the evening. I sleep at night.

sections.heading: Grammar tip
sections.body: مع الضمير I نستخدم الفعل بصيغته الأساسية: I work, I study, I eat. لا نضيف s إلى الفعل مع I.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence.
quiz.explanation: مع I نستخدم study دون s.

quiz.question: What does “wake up” mean?
quiz.explanation: Wake up تعني يستيقظ.

quiz.question: Complete: I ___ breakfast in the morning.
quiz.explanation: نستخدم eat مع I.

lessons.title: Food, drinks and ordering
lessons.description: تعلم أسماء أطعمة ومشروبات واطلب شيئًا بأدب في مقهى أو مطعم.
objectives: استخدام I would like لطلب شيء

vocabulary.example: Can I have some water, please?
Can I see the menu, please?
I'd like a cup of tea, please.

sections.heading: At a café
sections.body: Customer: Hello. I'd like a cup of tea, please.\nServer: Of course. Would you like bread, too?\nCustomer: No, thank you. How much is the tea?

sections.heading: Language tip
sections.body: استخدم I'd like بدل I want عندما تريد طلب شيء بأدب. أضف please لجعل الطلب ألطف.

quiz.question: Which is a polite way to order tea?
options: I'd like a cup of tea, please.
quiz.explanation: I'd like... صيغة مهذبة لطلب شيء.

quiz.question: What does menu mean?
quiz.explanation: Menu تعني قائمة الطعام أو المشروبات.

quiz.question: Complete: How ___ is the sandwich?
quiz.explanation: نستخدم How much للسؤال عن السعر.

lessons.title: Places and asking for directions
lessons.description: تعلم السؤال عن أماكن قريبة وفهم الاتجاهات الأساسية.

vocabulary.example: The bank is on the right.
Go straight ahead for two minutes.
The pharmacy is near the school.

sections.heading: Asking for help
sections.body: A: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?\nB: Go straight ahead, then turn left. It is near the school.\nA: Thank you!

sections.heading: Language tip
sections.body: استخدم Where is...? للسؤال عن المكان. Turn left تعني انعطف يسارًا، وturn right تعني انعطف يمينًا.

quiz.question: What does turn left mean?
quiz.explanation: Left تعني اليسار.

quiz.question: Choose the correct question.
quiz.explanation: الصيغة الصحيحة للسؤال عن مكان مفرد هي Where is the...?

lessons.title: Time, days and simple plans
lessons.description: تحدث عن الوقت وأيام الأسبوع وحدد موعدًا بسيطًا.

sections.heading: Making a plan
sections.body:
A: Are you free tomorrow?
B: Yes. What time is the lesson?
A: At seven in the evening.
B: Great. See you tomorrow!

sections.heading: Language tip
sections.body: نستخدم at مع وقت محدد: at seven, at nine thirty. ونستخدم on مع أيام الأسبوع: on Monday.

quiz.question: Complete: The lesson starts ___ seven.
quiz.explanation: نستخدم at قبل وقت محدد مثل at seven.

quiz.question: What does tomorrow mean?
quiz.explanation: Tomorrow تعني غدًا.

lessons.title: Places and asking for directions
lessons.description: تعلم أسماء الأماكن وطلب الاتجاهات بأدب.
objectives: Understand left, right and straight ahead.

vocabulary.example: The hotel is near the park.

sections.heading: A short conversation
sections.body: A: Excuse me, where is the museum? B: Go straight ahead and turn left. A: Is it near the park? B: Yes, it is.

sections.heading: Language tip / ملاحظة
sections.body: Use “Excuse me” to get someone's attention politely.

quiz.question: What does “Turn left” mean?
quiz.explanation: Turn left تعني انعطف يسارًا.

quiz.question: Choose a polite question.
quiz.explanation: نستخدم Where is…? ويمكن إضافة please للتهذيب.

lessons.title: Shopping and prices
lessons.description: تدرب على السؤال عن السعر والشراء في متجر.

vocabulary.example: Can I have a receipt, please?
I would like a bottle of water.

sections.heading: At the shop
sections.body: Customer: How much is this shirt? Shop assistant: It is ten dollars. Customer: Great. I would like one, please.

sections.heading: Language tip / ملاحظة
sections.body: Use “How much is…?” for one item and “How much are…?” for plural items.

quiz.question: How do you ask about a price?
quiz.explanation: How much is it? تعني كم سعره؟

quiz.question: Complete: I ___ like a coffee, please.
quiz.explanation: I would like… صيغة مهذبة للطلب.

lessons.title: Time and daily schedules
lessons.description: تعلّم الوقت والمواعيد والتعبير عن أوقات اليوم.

vocabulary.example: The lesson starts at nine o’clock.

sections.heading: Making plans
sections.body: A: What time is the meeting? B: At ten o’clock tomorrow. A: Thank you. See you then.

sections.heading: Language tip / ملاحظة
sections.body: Use “at” with clock times: at nine, at half past two.

quiz.question: Which word means غدًا?
quiz.explanation: Tomorrow تعني غدًا.

quiz.question: Complete: The class starts ___ eight.
quiz.explanation: نستخدم at مع الساعة المحددة.

lessons.title: Home and family
lessons.description: مفردات الأسرة والمنزل ووصف الأشياء البسيطة.

sections.heading: Describing a home
sections.body: I live with my family. Our home has two bedrooms and a small kitchen. The living room is comfortable.

sections.heading: Language tip / ملاحظة
sections.body: Use “my” for something belonging to you: my family, my room.

quiz.question: Where do you cook?
quiz.explanation: Kitchen تعني مطبخ.

quiz.question: Choose the correct phrase.
quiz.explanation: نستخدم my قبل الاسم للدلالة على الملكية.

lessons.title: Health and appointments
lessons.description: عبارات أساسية للتحدث عن الصحة وحجز موعد.

vocabulary.example: The pharmacy is across the street.

sections.heading: At the clinic
sections.body: Patient: I have a headache. Receptionist: Would you like an appointment? Patient: Yes, please.

sections.heading: Language tip / ملاحظة
sections.body: “I have a…” is useful for symptoms. This is language practice, not medical advice.

quiz.question: What is a pharmacy?
quiz.explanation: Pharmacy تعني صيدلية.

quiz.question: Choose a polite request.
options: Could I have an appointment, please?
quiz.explanation: Could I…? صيغة مهذبة للطلب.

lessons.title: Talking about yesterday (A2)
lessons.description: ابدأ الانتقال إلى A2 بوصف أحداث انتهت في الماضي.

sections.heading: A short story
sections.body: Yesterday, I went to the market. I bought some fruit and visited my friend. In the evening, we watched a film.

sections.heading: Language tip / ملاحظة
sections.body: Regular verbs often add -ed; some common verbs are irregular: go → went, buy → bought.

quiz.question: What is the past of “go”?
quiz.explanation: Go فعل غير منتظم، وماضيه went.

quiz.question: Complete: I ___ a film yesterday.
quiz.explanation: نستخدم watched للحدث المكتمل في الماضي.

lessons.title: Family, people and descriptions
lessons.description: تعلّم الحديث عن الأسرة والأشخاص ووصفهم بجمل قصيرة.
objectives: استخدام is وare في جمل بسيطة

sections.heading: Short conversation
sections.body:
A: Do you have a brother?
B: Yes, I have one brother and two sisters.
A: What is your sister like?
B: She is friendly and funny.

sections.heading: Grammar tip
sections.body: Use is with he, she and it: She is friendly. Use are with you, we and they: They are friendly. Use my before a family word to show relation: my brother.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence.
quiz.explanation: نستخدم is مع she.

quiz.question: What does “parents” mean?
quiz.explanation: Parents تعني الوالدين.

lessons.title: Shopping, prices and money
lessons.description: تدرّب على السؤال عن الأسعار وشراء الأشياء بأدب.

vocabulary.example: Can I have a receipt, please?

sections.heading: At the shop
sections.body:
Customer: Excuse me, how much is this shirt?
Shop assistant: It is fifteen dollars.
Customer: Can I pay by card?
Shop assistant: Yes, of course.

sections.heading: Useful language
sections.body: Ask “How much is this?” for one item. Say “I'd like…” or “Can I have…?” to make a polite request. Prices and payment options vary by shop.

quiz.question: How do you ask for the price?
quiz.explanation: How much is it? تعني كم سعره؟

quiz.question: What is a receipt?
quiz.explanation: Receipt تعني إيصالًا.

lessons.title: Directions and getting around
lessons.description: اسأل عن الطريق والمواصلات والأماكن القريبة.

vocabulary.example: The bank is on this street.
The court is near the station.

sections.heading: Asking for directions
sections.body:
A: Excuse me, where is the bus station?
B: Go straight ahead and turn right. It is near the bank.
A: Thank you.
B: You're welcome.

sections.heading: Language tip
sections.body: Use “Where is…?” to ask about a place. Direction phrases often begin with an action: go straight, turn left, cross the street. Follow local signs and instructions.

quiz.question: What does “turn left” mean?
quiz.explanation: Turn left تعني انعطف يسارًا.

quiz.question: Complete: Go ___ ahead.
quiz.explanation: التعبير الصحيح هو go straight ahead.

lessons.title: Talking about yesterday: past simple
lessons.description: تعلّم وصف أحداث انتهت في الماضي باستخدام past simple.

sections.heading: A short story
sections.body: Yesterday, I went to the library. I saw an old friend and we talked for an hour. I bought a notebook before I went home.

sections.heading: Grammar tip
sections.body: Use the past form for completed past events: go → went, buy → bought, see → saw. For many regular verbs, add -ed: visit → visited. For negatives, use did not + base verb: I did not go.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence.
quiz.explanation: Went هو الماضي من go.

quiz.question: Complete: She ___ a book yesterday.
quiz.explanation: Bought هو الماضي من buy.

lessons.title: Plans and invitations
lessons.description: عبّر عن خططك القريبة وادعُ الآخرين إلى نشاط.

vocabulary.example: I have a plan for tomorrow.
I'd like to invite you to dinner.

sections.heading: Making plans
sections.body:
A: Are you available tomorrow?
B: I think so. Why?
A: I'm going to visit the museum. Would you like to come?
B: Sounds good! What time shall we meet?

sections.heading: Grammar tip
sections.body: Use be going to + base verb for plans: I am going to study. Use “Would you like to…?” for a polite invitation. “I’m afraid I can’t” is a polite way to decline.

quiz.question: Choose the correct plan.
quiz.explanation: الصيغة: am/is/are + going to + الفعل الأساسي.

quiz.question: Which phrase politely invites someone?
options: Would you like to join us?
quiz.explanation: Would you like to…? صيغة مهذبة للدعوة.
